message: Scaled 2 of 5 feed rates to 80 %; 1 left as a thread pitch, 2 left because the code means a threading cycle in another G-code system, 1 rounded to the decimals it was written with.

findings.message: F2.0 is a thread pitch (G32), so it is not scaled.

F2.0 is not scaled: G76 is a threading cycle in another G-code system of this dialect, where this F is the thread lead and not a feed rate. Check the block and scale it by hand if it really is a feed.

F2.0 is not scaled: G92 is a threading cycle in another G-code system of this dialect, where this F is the thread lead and not a feed rate. Check the block and scale it by hand if it really is a feed.
F0.3 becomes 0.2, not 0.24: this value is written with 1 decimal and the result was rounded to it. Ask for more decimal places if that is too coarse.
